cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've bowed like you. Respect first. Now turn the gravity dial politely and we'll get your sofa off the ceiling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was ducking under it. I'm losing my deposit; how do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Head safely lowered, yes. Pause at each number. They dislike being passed over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six clicked, but now the armchairs are rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six has invited witnesses. Apologise to the whole suite; it has to hear you together.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's chairs as witnesses, though the required shared hearing is not expressed cleanly.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's final clause is detachable awkward phrasing and deserves a direct line edit rather than a passing-score excuse.
